PARLIAMENTARY ELECTION- 2024
Section 127 B of the Parliamentary Elections Act, No. 1 of 1981

FACILITIES FOR VOTING AT ANOTHER POLLING STATION FOR THOSE WHO HAVE A REASONABLE FEAR OF NOT BEING ABLE TO CAST VOTE AT A GIVEN POLLING STATION DUE TO THE CONDITIONS PREVAILING IN THE AREA WITHIN WHICH HIS POLLING STATION IS SITUATED

DUE to the prevailing situation in the area where his polling station is situated, an elector who is reasonably fearful that he will not be able to go to and cast the vote at the given polling station, may request to be facilitated to vote at another polling station. The provisions of Section 127 B of the Parliamentary Elections Act, No. 1 of 1981, as amended by the Parliamentary Elections Act, No. 15 of 1988, have provided in this regard.

02. The relevant applications can be obtained from Ofﬁ ces of all District Returning Ofﬁ cers / District Election Ofﬁ ces as well as from Divisional Secretariats and Grama Niladhari Ofﬁ ces. The applications must be forwarded to reach the Commissioner General of Elections, Election Commission, Sarana Mawatha, Rajagiriya within a week from the date of the nomination notice, i. e from 24.09.2024.

03. The application forms must be certiﬁ ed by the Grama Niladhari of the applicant's residence and the applicant must include the National Identity Card number in the form. Applications submitted without the Grama Niladhari Certiﬁ cate will be rejected.
